name: net_silent_link_plate
description: Tamsin's window's link goes silent without a close (nothing gets through either way, as when Wi-Fi is lost or a router stalls). Within about 5 s the window says so: the Reconnecting plate, the command card greyed and orders refused for the reconnect, instead of a frozen world with a live card and her own full link bars. The game drops the silent link and reconnects with a resume HELLO on a new one, which takes her seat back; the plate goes.

steps.msg: within about 5 s of the silence

steps.assert: not Game.accepts_commands() and Game.command_refusal() == 'Reconnecting to the server'
steps.msg: orders are refused, and say why
a resume on a new link took the seat back
